reason: E2 states that high specific surface area of powder leads to in-flight oxidation, supporting the link between particle size and oxidation. However, no cited evidence supports the claims that reduced oxidation increases deposition per particle, that this yields a thicker coating, or that coarser particles can be fully melted under the existing parameters.

Lower specific surface area reduces in-flight oxidation during thermal spray
